headline: 瑪丹娜新專輯回歸舞池
context: 流行天后瑪丹娜（Madonna）推出新專輯《Confessions II》，是 2005 年暢銷專輯《Confessions on a Dance Floor》的續作。樂評形容這是她近二十年來最具生命力的一張專輯，也是她一貫「拒絕懷舊」路線裡少見的回望之作。

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: On “Confessions II,” a successor to her hit 2005 album “Confessions on a Dance Floor,” the pop superstar gives new energy to her origin story and shines light on the troubles she’s danced away.
sources.title: ‘Confessions II’ Review: Madonna Returns to the Dance Floor

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The veteran pop diva has pressed rewind to move forward on her new record – and beneath the bangers fizz a host of emotionally charged memories • Confessions II review – nostalgic dancefloor trip sparks her most vital album in two decades “Madonna never reflects, she’s always moving forward,” Warner PR Liz Rosenberg told me in 2005, when after a frustrating few months laid up after a riding accident, Madonna re-emerged “like a bullet from a gun” with the glorious disco-driven Confessions on a Dance Floor, produced largely alongside Stuart Price. Madonna has always been militantly anti-nostalgia: continual reinvention is crucial to her artistic identity. But arguably, Confessions was – until last week – her last great record. Constantly trying to push forward has not always worked for Madonna, with the multiple producers and genres of her 2010s output often proving inconsistent and confusing: the muscular funk of 2008’s Hard Candy , the busy powerpop of 2015’s Rebel Heart , 2019’s globe-straddling Madame X . Leaving Warner Records in 2007 started the decline: Madonna had struck hugely lucrative deals with Live Nation and Interscope, but pressure to recoup that investment meant an element of compromise in her practice and adapting to another contemporary pop innovation: songwriting camps and production by committee. In 2015, Madonna complained to Rolling Stone about “working with people who can’t get off their phone, can’t stop tweeting, can’t focus and finish a song”. Continue reading...

thread_text:
瑪丹娜新專輯回歸舞池

流行天后瑪丹娜（Madonna）推出新專輯《Confessions II》，是 2005 年暢銷專輯《Confessions on a Dance Floor》的續作。樂評形容，這張專輯讓她的音樂重新有了活力，也在勁歌後藏著她過去努力甩開的一些心事。

2005 年那張《Confessions》主要與製作人史都華・普萊斯（Stuart Price）合作，此後瑪丹娜在 2007 年離開華納唱片，2010 年代的作品——2008《Hard Candy》、2015《Rebel Heart》、2019《Madame X》——評價則相對不穩定。樂評稱瑪丹娜一貫「拒絕懷舊」，但《Confessions II》成了她近二十年來難得的回望之作。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 7 日發佈的報導。

瑪丹娜新專輯回歸舞池

流行天后瑪丹娜（Madonna）推出新專輯《Confessions II》，是 2005 年暢銷專輯《Confessions on a Dance Floor》的續作。樂評形容，這張專輯讓她的音樂重新有了活力，也在勁歌後藏著她過去努力甩開的一些心事。

2005 年那張《Confessions》主要與製作人史都華・普萊斯（Stuart Price）合作。此後瑪丹娜 2007 年離開華納唱片，轉與 Live Nation、Interscope 簽下鉅額合約，2010 年代的作品——2008《Hard Candy》、2015《Rebel Heart》、2019《Madame X》——評價則相對不穩定。瑪丹娜 2015 年還曾向《滾石》雜誌抱怨過，合作對象「機不離手，沒辦法專心寫完一首歌」。樂評稱她一貫「拒絕懷舊」，但《Confessions II》成了她近二十年來難得的回望之作。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 7 日發佈的報導。
